items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: But this Eckles, he used to wear a white suit, and he wore a white hat... And he was a trumpet player too.

ctx.x: Well, there was, but there weren't a lot of people involved. They were more or less the same group. Like if you got by whoever Les Hite had, you had pretty well picked the capable players. There wasn't much left. Well, C. L. Burke, he was the one who played the

Hawaiian guitar, and he was the guitar player in that band. But -- the one that made some records with Pops. But if you went by that group the next step down was a big step. But this Eckles, he used to wear a white suit, and he wore a white hat, something like the one I've got on here. And he was a trumpet player too. And he used to play -- do you know what a gloria trumpet it? That's a straight trumpet, just like the one they call the horses out with, only it had valves. And Buck Clayton was in the band. He was…
Gee. That was -- yeah. There wasn't any mixing on bandstands, right?
